wallpaper_dir.label: Base Wallpaper Directory
wallpaper_dir.description: Base directory for wallpapers. If no slots are configured below, subfolders will be scanned.

apply_palette.label: Apply Color Palette
apply_palette.description: Automatically apply the folder's assigned color palette to Noctalia when applying a wallpaper.

notify_on_change.label: Notify on Change
notify_on_change.description: Show a desktop notification when the wallpaper or favorite status changes.

close_on_apply.label: Close on Apply
close_on_apply.description: Automatically close the Wallpaper Widget carousel after applying a wallpaper.
